day_summary: A cold front is crossing the central and eastern US today: overnight passage at Minneapolis/Chicago (midnight highs already printed), the front pushing through Louisville and Atlanta late morning into evening, a frontal boundary reaching Oklahoma City by mid-afternoon, and post-frontal air already in place in Texas/Louisiana. Frontal timing is the day's dominant error source; the West is mostly clear under high pressure. Tag assigned from the morning NWS forecast discussions BEFORE candidate selection, per Amendment 3, and never revised after outcomes.
